rows: Team must discuss, describe, display, or document their plan(s) which includes at least one of the following: finances and financial sustainability plan, season project planning, and/or team sustainability plans and/or objectives.
Team must discuss, describe, display or document how a team tracks their progress towards their plan(s) listed above.
Team has clear team roles for all members of the team and a process for developing leadership.
Team can discuss, describe, display, or document how they manage the team’s constraints and/or risks.
